acceptance_criteria.text: A name of 1 to 50 characters and a message of 1 to 500 characters (after trimming, counted as visible characters) are accepted; empty, whitespace-only, 51-character names and 501-character messages are rejected, on submission as well as in the form.

Messages are listed newest first, 20 per page, with working Older/Newer links, a page number in the URL, clamping of out-of-range or invalid page numbers, and an empty-state message when there are none.
Message and name text containing HTML or Markdown is displayed literally and escaped, never executed or interpreted; line breaks in messages are preserved.
A valid submission is stored, redirects to a confirmation, clears the form and isn't resubmitted on reload; an invalid one keeps the typed text, shows errors beside the fields and stores nothing.

With the recommended spam controls, a submission with the hidden honeypot filled isn't stored, and submissions over the rate limit are refused with a try-again-later message that keeps the typed text.
Stored messages survive a restart, concurrent submissions are all stored, and a storage failure shows a plain unavailable message without technical details.
All guestbook code lives in guestbook/ and the change doesn't add to, edit or depend on anything outside that folder, including the to-do app from #10.
The page can be used by keyboard alone and on a narrow phone screen without sideways scrolling, with labelled fields and announced errors and confirmation.
The owner's answers to the five open decisions (moderation, data kept, spam, storage, who can read) are recorded in guestbook/README.md and the implementation matches them.
